name: UV Protection Sunglasses
description: Block out harmful UV rays with these sleek polarized sunglasses. Classic wayfarer-style frames in matte black with 100% UVA/UVB protection. Perfect for beach trips, outdoor activities, or everyday summer wear. Lightweight and durable frame fits most face shapes comfortably.

name: Cooling Ice Towel (4-Pack)
description: Stay cool all summer long with these instant cooling towels. Made from hyper-evaporative material that cools down to 30°F below body temperature within seconds. Comes in a portable zip-lock bag with a carabiner clip. Perfect for outdoor workouts, sports, hiking, and hot summer days.

name: Insulated Water Bottle 40oz
description: Keep your drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12 hours with this double-wall vacuum insulated stainless steel bottle. Comes with 3 lids including a straw lid and spout lid. Includes a paracord handle, carrying pouch, and straw cleaner. BPA-free and sweat-proof exterior.

name: Cotton Baseball Cap (3-Pack)
description: Classic structured baseball caps in a value 3-pack — black, navy, and gray. Made from breathable cotton with an adjustable back strap for a perfect fit. Low-profile design with UV-blocking fabric. Great for outdoor activities, travel, or casual everyday wear. One size fits most adults.

name: Oversized Boxy T-Shirt (3-Pack)
description: Premium heavyweight cotton tees in a relaxed oversized fit. Available as a 3-pack in white, navy, and black. Features a drop shoulder, wide neckband, and comfortable boxy silhouette. Made from 100% ring-spun cotton for a soft, breathable feel that keeps you cool all summer.

name: Rechargeable Portable Fan
description: Powerful 10000mAh rechargeable battery fan with LED battery display. Foldable kickstand for desk or table use. 3 speed settings and ultra-quiet motor. Works for up to 24 hours on low speed. Perfect for outdoor camping, office desks, power outages, and hot summer days. USB-C charging.
